name: Project archive
description: Close a PARA project, preserve lessons, and move reusable material to the right long-term bucket.

nodes.label: Review outcome
nodes.description: Compare the project outcome against the original success criteria and current reality.

artifact.description: Outcome review, what shipped, what changed, and what did not happen.

nodes.label: Extract lessons
nodes.description: Capture durable lessons, reusable patterns, and warnings as memories or artifacts.

artifact.description: Reusable lessons from the project and suggested memory updates.

nodes.label: Reclassify material
nodes.description: Move or retag durable outputs into area, resource, or archive buckets.

artifact.description: PARA reclassification plan for project artifacts and references.

nodes.label: Close loops
nodes.description: Mark completed tasks done, cancel obsolete tasks, and create follow-up tasks only for live commitments.

artifact.description: Task closure and remaining follow-up actions.

nodes.label: Finalize archive note
nodes.description: Write and finalize the archive note with a para:archive/<slug> or successor bucket tag.

artifact.description: Final project archive note suitable for future retrieval.
